Hi Julia —

Great conversation earlier today — thanks again for walking through Avenue Health's objectives around real-time inference and cost predictability. Quick recap from my side:

- Primary goal: run extractive and summarization models against patient-facing transcripts with sub-150ms p50 token latency for short sequences.
- Data constraints: must remain in a VPC-controlled environment for PHI scope; KMS-managed keys are preferred.
- Success signals: latency under target for 95th percentile during peak, predictable per-token costs, and an initial pilot across two clinics.

Next step: 30-minute product intro + brief technical Q&A (we'll include an engineer). Below are three windows that work for our team — please pick one that fits your stakeholder group or suggest alternatives:

1) Tue Apr 5 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Wed Apr 6 — 11:30–12:00 PM PT
3) Thu Apr 7 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT

If helpful, I can include a short agenda and a one-page overview (attached). Would you prefer we invite our solutions engineer to the whole slot or just the last 10 minutes?

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

Best,
